title.narrative: Maternal and Newborn Health and Rights - Grassroots Advocacy

description.narrative:
Support to Reproductive and Birth Justice: Grassroots Advocacy (“the Project”).
Overview: The Project will contribute to lower global maternal and newborn mortality, through the nurturing of a global ‘Birth Justice’ movement that strengthens and builds grassroots ‘voice’ and advocacy for maternal and newborn health by providing funding and coordination to nascent movements. The focus is on enabling the most marginalized women and children, especially the poorest, those in humanitarian settings, adolescents, those living with disability and those most affected by climate change, to push for the changes they need, linked to global policy efforts.
